name: Pen cup
definition: open pot that stands pens and pencils upright on a desk.

name: Pencil case
definition: Pouch, box or roll that holds several pens and pencils; a sleeve for one pen is a Pen sleeve.

name: Document tray
definition: flat open tray, often stackable, that holds papers on a desk.

name: Magazine holder
definition: upright open-sided box that holds magazines or files on a desk or shelf.

name: Desk pad
definition: large mat or blotting pad laid on the desk top to write on.

name: Noticeboard
definition: cork or fabric board to which notices are pinned.

name: Whiteboard
definition: smooth board written on with dry-erase markers.

name: Stapler
definition: Device that drives a wire staple through sheets to join them.

name: Hole punch
definition: device that cuts filing holes in sheets.

name: Paper trimmer
definition: guillotine or rotary cutter that trims sheets straight.

name: Scissors
definition: General-purpose scissors for paper and household use.

name: Rubber stamp
definition: Hand stamp with a rubber die for dates, words or marks on office papers; decorative stamps are in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Stamp ink pad
definition: Inked pad for office stamps; ink pads for decorative stamps are in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Name seal
definition: Personal seal stamped as a signature, used in Japan.

name: Paper clip
definition: bent wire loop that clips sheets together.

name: Bulldog clip
definition: sprung metal clip that grips a thick stack of sheets.

name: Drawing pin
definition: short pin with a flat head pressed into a board to hold paper.

name: Glue stick
definition: Solid glue in a twist-up tube for sticking paper.

name: Desk tape
definition: Narrow transparent adhesive tape for paper and desk use.

name: Tape dispenser
definition: weighted holder with a cutting edge for desk tape.

name: Ring binder
definition: stiff cover with a ring mechanism that holds punched sheets.

name: Lever arch file
definition: binder with a lever-operated two-ring arch mechanism for large volumes of sheets.

name: Box file
definition: lidded box-shaped file with a spring clip that holds loose papers.

name: Ruler
definition: straight strip with a graduated scale for measuring and ruling lines.

name: Geometry set
definition: case of drawing compass, protractor, set squares and ruler sold as one set.

name: Drawing compass
definition: Two-legged instrument that draws circles and arcs (a navigation compass is in Sports, Fitness & Recreation).

name: Postal scale
definition: Small scale for weighing letters and parcels for postage.

name: Basic calculator
definition: calculator for the four operations and percentages, with a display.

name: Printing calculator
definition: desktop calculator that prints its figures on a paper roll.

name: Scientific calculator
definition: calculator with trigonometric, logarithmic and statistical functions.

name: Graphing calculator
definition: programmable calculator that plots functions on a graphic display.

name: Financial calculator
definition: calculator with time-value-of-money and other finance functions.

name: Abacus
definition: Frame of beads on rods moved by hand to calculate; the Japanese soroban is one form.

name: Slide rule
definition: Pair of sliding logarithmic scales for multiplying and dividing.

name: Shredder
definition: Machine that cuts paper into strips or particles.

name: Laminator
definition: machine that seals a sheet between plastic films by heat or pressure.

name: Binding machine
definition: machine that punches and binds sheets with combs, wires or covers.

name: Label maker
definition: Device that prints adhesive labels on tape; it may stand alone or connect to a computer or phone.

name: Typewriter
definition: Machine that prints characters on paper as keys are struck, manual or electric.

name: Fountain pen ink
definition: Bottled ink made for fountain pens; sold by dye or pigment, wetness, saturation, shading, sheen, water resistance and colour.

name: Fountain pen cartridge
definition: sealed ink cartridge that fits a fountain pen's cartridge standard.

name: Fountain pen converter
definition: refillable piston or squeeze reservoir that fits in place of a cartridge.

name: Fountain pen nib
definition: nib or nib unit sold to fit a fountain pen.

name: Pen refill
definition: ink refill made to fit a ballpoint, gel, rollerball or multi pen.

name: Pencil leads
definition: Tube of leads made for mechanical pencils, in different grades and diameters.

name: Pen sleeve
definition: Sleeve or case that holds one pen.

name: Planner or notebook cover
definition: cover made for one planner or notebook system, sold separately.

name: Refill notebook
definition: refill book made for one cover or notebook system.

name: Planner index tabs
definition: Tabs made to fit one planner system.

name: Staples
definition: wire staples in strips made to fit a stapler.

name: Label tape
definition: Tape cartridge made to fit one label-maker system.

name: Fountain pen
definition: Pen that feeds liquid ink from a reservoir to a split nib; filling system, nib size and shape, and body material vary.

name: Dip pen
definition: Holder with loose nibs dipped in a separate bottle of ink; a dip pen sold for comics or drawing only is in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Ballpoint pen
definition: Pen that rolls thick oil-based ink onto paper through a ball tip; a digital pen that writes in ink and records the writing is included.

name: Gel pen
definition: ball-tip pen with water-based gel ink.

name: Rollerball pen
definition: Ball-tip pen with liquid water-based ink; a digital pen of this type that records the writing is included.

name: Multi pen
definition: one barrel holding several ball or gel refills (and sometimes a pencil) selected in turn.

name: Felt-tip pen
definition: fine fibre-tip pen made for writing, or for writing and drawing both.

name: Marker pen
definition: broad fibre or felt-tip pen for marking and labelling.

name: Highlighter
definition: broad-tip pen with translucent fluorescent ink for marking text.

name: Brush pen
definition: Pen with a flexible brush tip sold for handwriting, lettering or calligraphy (fudepens included); brush pens for drawing only are in Craft & Art Supplies.

name: Calligraphy brush
definition: hair brush made for East Asian calligraphy.

name: Ink stick
definition: solid stick of soot and binder ground on an inkstone to make calligraphy ink.

name: Inkstone
definition: stone slab with a well on which an ink stick is ground with water.

name: Calligraphy set
definition: Brush, ink and inkstone sold as one kit.

name: Wooden pencil
definition: graphite core cased in wood, sharpened to use.

name: Mechanical pencil
definition: refillable holder that advances a thin lead by a mechanism.

name: Eraser
definition: block of rubber or plastic that rubs out pencil or ink marks.

name: Correction tape
definition: dispenser that lays a dry white film over a written mark.

name: Correction fluid
definition: quick-drying white liquid brushed or penned over a written mark.

name: Pencil sharpener
definition: Device that sharpens a wooden pencil, manual or electric.

name: Notebook
definition: Bound book of blank, lined, dot or graph sheets for notes; also called a journal.

name: Composition book
definition: sewn notebook with a stiff marbled-style board cover and lined pages.

name: Refillable notebook system
definition: Cover plus refill books sold together as one system (the TRAVELER'S notebook is one); covers and refills sold separately are under Planner covers & refills.

name: Diary or planner
definition: Bound book ruled by date or for dates (daily, weekly, monthly), dated or undated; the Hobonichi Techo is an example.

name: Calendar
definition: Printed sheets of the days, weeks or months of a year, for the wall, desk or pocket.

name: Sticky-note calendar
definition: Tear-off or sticky-note day calendar, one sheet per day.

name: Loose-leaf paper
definition: punched loose sheets made for a binder.

name: Memo pad
definition: glued or bound pad of tear-off sheets for short notes.

name: Sticky notes
definition: pad of small sheets with a repositionable adhesive strip ("adhesive notes" in Australia).

name: Letter-writing paper set
definition: writing sheets sold with matching envelopes for letters ("letter set").

name: Printer paper
definition: Plain cut sheets sold by the ream for copiers and printers; photographic paper is in Cameras & Photography.

name: Envelope
definition: Folded paper cover for posting a letter or document.

name: Padded envelope
definition: Envelope lined with bubble or paper padding for posting small items.

name: Mailing tube
definition: Rigid tube for posting rolled documents.

name: Greeting card
definition: folded printed card with envelope, sold blank inside or with a message, to be written and sent.

name: Gift wrap
definition: printed or decorated paper sold for wrapping presents.

name: Sticker sheet
definition: Sheet of printed self-adhesive stickers sold as stationery (a collectible sticker series is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards).

name: Index card
definition: Cut card of plain or ruled stock sold in packs for notes, filing and revision; when blank it is also a flash card.

name: Folder
definition: Card or plastic cover, folded, pocketed or flapped, that holds loose unpunched sheets without rings or clips.

name: Treasury tag
definition: Short cord with a metal or plastic tag at each end, threaded through punched holes to hold sheets together.

name: Paper fastener
definition: Brass or metal pin with two flat legs pushed through sheets and bent back to join them.

name: Punched pocket
definition: Clear plastic sleeve, open at one edge and punched to file a sheet in a ring binder.

name: Rubber band
definition: Loop of rubber sold in boxes or bags for holding papers and desk items together.

name: Office magnet
definition: Small magnet button or strip for holding papers on a whiteboard or magnetic board.

name: Desk organiser
definition: Desk-top unit with several compartments for pens, notes and small supplies.

name: Laminating pouch
definition: Pair of plastic films joined at one edge, made to be sealed round a sheet in a laminator; sold in different sizes and thicknesses.

name: Binding comb
definition: Plastic comb, wire or slide spine made to bind punched sheets in a binding machine; sold in different diameters.

name: Binding cover
definition: Clear or card front and back sheet made to cover a machine-bound document.

name: Shredder bag
definition: Bag made to line the bin of a paper shredder.

name: Calculator ink roller
definition: Ink roller made to fit a printing calculator.

name: Clipboard
definition: Rigid board with a spring clip at the top that holds paper to write on.

name: Chalkboard
definition: Board with a dark surface written on with chalk.

name: Lead holder
definition: Holder whose clutch grips a thick graphite lead (2 mm or more) that drops when the button is pressed; sharpened in a lead pointer.
